name: Love & Life
source:
Love & Life is a short and light-hearted story about the school life of Kenta/ Hina after he/she transfers to a new school.
He/ She meets new friends and is involved in several fun activities. He/ She also discovers the stories behind his/ her new friends.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=12955]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
《Love & Life》是一段轻松诙谐的短篇故事，讲述健太或雏转入新学校后的校园生活。
主人公会结识新朋友，参与种种有趣活动，也会逐渐发现这些新朋友各自背后的故事。

[引自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=12955]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
